mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when HOUST growth is above its 12-month mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests expanding supply capacity, which reduces near-term price pressures and drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO exceeding its 6-month moving average by 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in job openings (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, which raises corporate profits and produces a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in a month while UNRATE falls by >0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when PAYEMS growth is not accompanied by UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 0.25% in a single month, it signals a shift to contractionary policy, which dampens equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising above its prior month's level.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2% for three consecutive months predicts a demand-driven equity rally, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly growth > 0.2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL growth pattern is absent.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 50-week moving average indicate weakening supply constraints, which typically precede a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 50-week moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO remaining below its 50-week MA for 4 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment (UNRATE) to below 3.5% triggers a strong labor market, which amplifies corporate hiring and supports a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE remains above 3.5% in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.1% for the first time in a tightening cycle, it creates risk aversion that produces a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
regime_hint: early in a rate hike cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS change is ≤ 0.1%.
